license_evidence.evidence: The owning gpui package declares license = Apache-2.0 at line 9 at both pins. Full Cargo.toml blobs differ; the declaration is independently verified at each pin.
The same Git symlink object at both pins resolves to the root Apache license text.
The resolved license text is byte-identical at both pins and identifies the Apache License, Version 2.0 and Zed Industries copyright.
A root GPL license also exists. This does not extend the GPUI package Apache finding to unrelated Zed paths.

bounded_core_contract.status: Independently authored implementation is core-tested; unchanged-main gaps and executed commands are retained separately in docs/evidence/tab-groups.
bounded_core_contract.api: with_tab_group_index(Int32?) with tab_group_index() query; None adds no group prefix. The signed Int32 value is separate from tab_index and tab_stop.
bounded_core_contract.ordering: Ancestor active group indices, including the node own group when present, followed by that focusable node own tab_index; ascending signed lexicographic comparison, shorter exact prefix first, stable preorder for equal full paths. Reverse traversal reverses the complete order.
bounded_core_contract.container_own_handle: A focusable group node participates with its own group prefix before its handle index. Descendants retain that prefix until their subtree ends. This is ordering, not a guarantee to enter every group from every anchor index.
bounded_core_contract.eligibility: Only live focusable tab stops are destinations; focusable non-stops remain anchors. Global wrap is preserved and groups do not trap focus.
preserved_contracts: Immutable snapshots and builder/layout/prepaint/scroll metadata preservation.
Existing focus owner lineage, acquisition and no-op traversal identity semantics.
Existing explicit input modality and route-only dispatch; no automatic Tab/Shift-Tab keymap interpretation.
bounded_core_contract.material_api_deviation: Upstream tab_group() reuses interactivity.tab_index as the group index and may default that field to zero. The bounded MoonBit API separates optional group index from handle tab_index and does not make it focusable or a tab stop.
